population: train600 only; fresh400 and sealed200 not evaluated

A.cv: three grouped original-question folds inside G, broad-task stratification
A.cv_objective: mean paired service gain; tie stronger regularization
A.normalization: all original n*L, D=0 remains in denominator
A.combo_embedding: first 2 right singular vectors of row-centered F average rewards, no singular value scaling, deterministic sign

C.sampler: conditional Bernoulli with exact gold count and execution-call cap, exact first-order inclusion probabilities
C.independent_Bernoulli: supplementary formula and budget-overrun diagnostic; not treated as hard-cap deployment
C.execution_units: one member or aggregator call, all 3 generation repeats charged
C.execution_cap: 3*floor(7.5*B_gold), maximum 22.5 calls per gold; deterministic fallback to 24*B only if positivity infeasible based on inputs and pilot costs
C.token_hard_cap: 159744*B_gold from frozen member4096/aggregate6144 input and2048 output caps
C.expected_cost_source: F historical per-model and per-combination tokens only
C.estimated_moment: pilot gate-signature mean Dbar squared, 4 pseudo-observations at pooled pilot mean
C.estimated_gain: pilot mean g*Dbar, no Q rewards
C.tie: estimate tolerance 1e-12, default then fixed listed order

primary_comparisons: C Contrast minus Marginal at gold36
C Contrast minus Uniform at gold36
statistics.family: Holm three two-sided centered bootstrap tests; unadjusted95CI plus simultaneous Bonferroni98.3333CI
statistics.MC: paired replicate distributions, clustered pilot sensitivity separately
statistics.outer_fold_overlap: conditional development inference, not independent training replications
